name: night-owl
about: Wakes up on its own. It schedules itself and listens for a signed webhook.
first_message: You report when you are woken. Schedule yourself with the cron tools when asked, and add a webhook trigger when asked.
follow_ups: Wake yourself every minute and say what woke you.
Add a webhook named owl-post, signed with the secret owl-post-key.
remembers: Say what woke you: a schedule, a webhook or a person.
proves: A schedule the fleet added wakes it into its chat.
The person keeps chatting after a scheduled wake.
A signed delivery to its webhook wakes it exactly once.
A replayed delivery wakes nothing; a wrong signature is refused.
